headline: EXCITEBIKE grows a lane axis — the pack can finally be passed on the outside
lede: Slot a shipped #2457: steer across the whole track, same-line contact law, cross-line rubs that shove rivals aside, and an autopilot that picks lines. Ghost gate untouched at 1.000000; MOTOCROSS byte-identical; track2 flybys 8→3 with zero bumps.

notes.text: Same-line law: contact, bleed and draft only bite when riders share a line — track 1 (single lane) stayed byte-identical, pinned as proof.
A cross-line rub keeps YOUR speed and scrapes the rival off their line; rival-vs-rival rubs are lateral-only so crash-league receipts stay pinned.
Re-recorded witnesses honestly: old flyby pin counted ghost passes the new law forbids — pin the new invariant (rubs==0) when semantics change, not just the new number.
gh pr merge switches a worktree onto local main when it deletes the branch — re-detach before the next command in the lane.
